title: Fair and Reasonable Provision and Maintenance on Divorce — Section 3 MWA

content.overview: Section 3 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986 deals with fair and reasonable provision and maintenance for a divorced Muslim woman, together with related provision for children, mahr/dower and properties as enacted. The provision is to be made within the iddat period but, as construed in Danial Latifi, can address future sustenance beyond iddat.
content.glance: Ask: (1) Divorced Muslim woman? (2) Fair and reasonable provision under s. 3? (3) Within iddat for making provision? (4) Scope beyond iddat per Danial Latifi?
content.study:
s. 3 is the core post-divorce provision for Muslim women under the 1986 Act.

Case already in migrated file: Danial Latifi v. Union of India (2001) 7 SCC 740 — husband’s obligation to make a reasonable and fair provision is not confined to maintenance for the iddat period; the provision is to be made within the iddat period and can address future sustenance. No additional cases invented.
